{{- /* Old URL -> permalink of the page that now answers it, for one version folder (the argument is its dirpath). Aliases resolve the way Hugo and index.redir resolve them: page-relative, against the directory the page is written into, which for a section index is the section's parent. Built once per build via partialCached. */ -}} {{- $dirpath := . -}} {{- $base := strings.TrimSuffix "/" (urls.Parse site.BaseURL).Path -}} {{- $map := dict -}} {{- range where site.Pages "Section" $dirpath -}} {{- $dir := path.Dir (strings.TrimSuffix "/" (strings.TrimPrefix $base .RelPermalink)) -}} {{- $target := .Permalink -}} {{- range .Aliases -}} {{- $from := . -}} {{- if not (hasPrefix . "/") }}{{ $from = path.Join $dir . }}{{ end -}} {{- $map = merge $map (dict (printf "%s/" (strings.TrimSuffix "/" $from)) $target) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $map -}}
